title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Schedule of One-Time Charges
content:
The one-time charges of **Area and Security Lighting Rental** are listed below by fixture, in US dollars. Each is billed once per occurrence on the service account the light is billed on; per-pole and per-foot amounts are multiplied by the number of poles or feet concerned.

## Construction and change charges

| Fixture | Mounting on an existing cooperative pole | Each additional pole set for the light | Underground feed, per foot | Inspection of a member-owned pole | House-side shield | Relocation on the same premises | Cancellation after the location was staked |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 0.00 | 325.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 0.00 | 325.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 0.00 | 425.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 0.00 | 425.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 0.00 | 325.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 0.00 | 425.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 0.00 | 325.00 | 6.50 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 175.00 | 75.00 |

## Damage charges

| Fixture | Fixture damaged by the member or the member's guests | Light pole broken by the member's vehicle or equipment |
|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 85.00 | 650.00 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 85.00 | 650.00 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 125.00 | 650.00 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 125.00 | 650.00 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 85.00 | 650.00 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 125.00 | 650.00 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 85.00 | 650.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- Mounting a fixture on an existing cooperative pole costs nothing for any fixture.
- The additional-pole charge and the fixture damage charge each have two levels: the flood lights (LED 110W, LED 150W and HPS 250W) carry 425.00 per additional pole and 125.00 for fixture damage; the other four fixtures carry 325.00 and 85.00.
- The figures are published for every fixture. Whether a given piece of work may be done for a fixture at all is a matter of the construction standards, not of this schedule.

### Hypothetical figures

- Two additional poles for an LED 150W Flood Light: two poles at 425.00 each, 850.00 in total.
- 120 feet of underground feed for an LED 40W Security Light: 120 feet at 6.50 per foot, 780.00 in total.
